subject: Procedure division structure
notes: kb/Work PB640 + PB663. The PARTIAL residual PB640 recorded here is CLOSED: 'the SET leg for a class OBJECT or class POINTER formal - the callee-side formal carrier for those categories is emitted as the STRING carrier, so a NESTED CALL passing a USAGE POINTER or OBJECT REFERENCE item produces uncompilable C# ... BY REFERENCE and BY CONTENT alike'. A LINKAGE formal's carrier is now its own class's carrier through ONE classification both sides of the boundary read (CallCrossing: Native / Text / VarGroup / Managed), so GR9's second-branch allocated record for a class-pointer or class-object-reference formal is a detached cell of the formal's own PicInfo.ClrType, filled by the reference copy that 'if the formal parameter is of class index, object, or pointer, a SET statement' names, and then aliased by CobolArgAdapt.Slot as GR9's closing sentence requires ('This record is then treated ... as if it were the argument and it were passed by reference'). The golden's AFTER-CON=SET row is that sentence measured: the callee's SET of the formal to NULL reaches the allocated record and the activator's pointer still addresses W-AREA. The BY REFERENCE twin (GR8) is the AFTER-REF=NULL row, where the same SET does reach the caller. The FIRST branch (no program-specifier, no NESTED) is unchanged and still carried by pb640's NOCONV row; 14.9.4.3 SR10 bars that branch only from carrying a class-pointer argument BY REFERENCE (`cite.py --check 14.9.4.3 "that identifier shall be neither a strongly-typed group item nor a data item of class object or pointer"` -> OK 10)). kb/Work PB970 arm 2: BY CONTENT the FIRST branch does carry one - 14.8.2.3.3 rule 1 (`cite.py --check 14.8.2.3.3 "the formal parameter shall be of the same length as the corresponding argument"` -> OK 1)) admits a POINTER / PROGRAM-POINTER / FUNCTION-POINTER into a same-length (8) non-pointer formal, and this rule's "That argument is moved to this allocated record without conversion" delivers the pointer's STORAGE image (DOC-A.1-216, the ONE codec PointerImage) in a detached string cell (CobolArgAdapt.WithPointerContent, asked by Text and Num). Measured before: EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH, the callee never ran; after: NULL = eight X'00', ADDRESS OF W a nonzero token, equal pointers equal images, the image read as BINARY-DOUBLE moves by n under SET UP BY n, the callee's store never reaches the caller. The second branch's rule-2d MOVE for the same pairing now refuses at bind (14.9.25.3 SR1 asked by OoConformance.MoveContentMismatch; COBOL1688). LinkageCarrierDriftTests walks PicCategory itself, so a class added to the model without a crossing arm is red rather than silently space-filled. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Oo/OoConformance.cs#MoveContentMismatch (kb/Work PB3101: the BY CONTENT comparator family is deleted; the MOVE question of a BY CONTENT argument is ActivationRelations.ContentMoveViolation, asked at bind time through ParameterConformance.ContentConformanceReason) || editions 85,2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): the BY CONTENT argument passing of COBOL-85's CALL; the REPOSITORY / NESTED legs it mentions are later refinements of the same rule. cite.py --check 14.2.3 "If the argument is passed by content" OK.
